params.name: Shape
params.desc: Sets the shape of the oscillators

params.name: Distortion
params.desc: Distortion amount to the oscillators

params.name: Pitch
params.desc: Fine tune of the pitch

params.name: Interval
params.desc: Sets the tuning interval between oscillators

params.name: Noise level
params.desc: Adds noise to the oscillators

params.name: Glide
params.desc: Controls the speed of the portamento

params.name: Resonance
params.desc: Adds resonance to the LPG filter

params.name: Latch
params.desc: Set the oscillator to latch mode (always on)

params.name: On/off
params.desc: Enables the arpeggiator

params.name: Order
params.desc: Selects the arpeggiator pattern

params.name: Clock division
params.desc: Sets the speed of the arpeggiator

params.name: Chance
params.desc: Sets the probability of the arpeggiator progressing on each tick of its clock

params.usage: 0~63: Steps negative values; 64: True random; 65~127: Positive values
params.desc: Sets the length of the euclidean pattern

params.name: Octaves
params.desc: Sets the octave range of the arpeggiator

params.desc: Sets the order of the steps played by the sequencer

params.name: Chance
params.desc: Sets the probability of the sequencer progressing on each tick of its clock

params.name: Euclid length

params.desc: Sets the length of the euclidean pattern

params.name: Gate length
params.desc: Sets the length of the gate of each step

params.desc: Selects the sequencer pattern
